blocks.note: Place non before a finite or clitic-bearing verb phrase, an infinitive, or a specifically contrasted constituent, while recognizing its reinforcing use in questions and exclamations; all sixteen items are unflagged.
Place o no, o meno, e non, and the expectation-sensitive colloquial negator mica according to the scope and discourse force of the sentence; all eleven items are unflagged.
Move negative pronouns, adverbs, and conjunctions across the verb while adding non after the verb and omitting it before the verb; all twelve transformations are unflagged.

Answer with non ancora, non più, non mai, non affatto, or non per niente according to whether the negation concerns onset, continuation, frequency, or degree; cap before the final item whose extracted prompt has absorbed the printed answer legend.
